My top OMGWTFBBQ moment has to be on Battlefield 2 when playin Wake Island with Drewley. I was in a MiG fighter jet and Drew was flying a helicopter at sea towards the aircraft carrier. I flew towards his helicopter (totally unplanned) and jumped out just metres above his helicopter and spammed 'e' next thing you know I was sitting in the gun seat to his Helicopter now thats stylish!!  [image not archived: Tongue]

Another Battlefield moment for my next OMGWTFBBQ moment this time it was on the old school Battlefield Veitnam [image not archived: Cheesy] I was just using the mortar (most underrated gun in that game mainly cause minges didn't know how they worked anyway) I was firing shells at random into this small village my E-penis growing with every explosion. When suddenly an American jet flew low over the village as I saw it blow up I looked up to the scoreboard to see Mortar killed Jet...I was actually speechless haha.

I have so many funny stories which have happened on games when I get time I'll share some more. Until then tell us what was your best Gaming OMGWTFBBQ Moment?!

posts.html:
My best OMGWTFBBQ moment was actually rather recent, on GTAIV online.

I was having a shootout with this fella, and we were strafing behind buildings and shix getting closer and closer. Well anyway, I was hiding behind a car, when he came towards me in a bin lorry (I have no idea where he got it from.). When he smashed into the car I sustained a large amountof damage, and I died and ended up in the back of the dump truck (I assume, I couldn't see my character, the camera was just following the back of it.).

So this was continueing for a while, I couldn't get out of it and he was laughing at me being stuck in the back. After about a minute, the lorry decided it would be rather fantastic if it spontaneously combusted. He died, and I ended up back in my sports car, completely fine, and able to drive away!

pretty longwinded, and I make it sound oh-so-not-funny, but we rofld for ages at the time!

hahaha  [image not archived: Grin]

Possibly on Halo 3.

We were playing Infection Oopp on xbox live (Oopp being a custom infection where you have a sniper and shotgun, with zombies that have almost 0 gravity and run at 50 m/s!) and I was the last human alive with three zombies running at me. I carefully aimed up my sights with the first zombies head and squeezed the trigger... and to my amazement, they all fell down dead. We watched the reply and the bullet ricocheted off the ground causing them all to simotaniously kill all  three zombies!

Great stuff to watch  [image not archived: Cheesy]
